_description: Response body returned by GET /api/model/stats — combines live corpus counts from the database with historical evaluation metrics from the most recent training run.

_notes.trained: False on fresh startup before the first training run completes.
_notes.lastTrainedAt: Null if the model has never been trained.
_notes.samplesUsedInLastRun: May differ from totalLabelled if new reviews were labelled after the last training run.
_notes.seedLabelledCount: Samples auto-labelled by the model when its confidence was high (labelSource=SEED).
_notes.manualLabelledCount: Samples labelled by a human operator via the API (labelSource=MANUAL).
_notes.claudeLabelledCount: Samples labelled by the Claude AI oracle when the model was uncertain (labelSource=CLAUDE).
_notes.retrainBatchProgress: Resets to zero after each automatic retraining run. When it reaches retrainBatchSize, a retrain is triggered.

_variant_trained_healthy._comment: A healthy trained model with a well-balanced corpus.

_variant_untrained._comment: Fresh deployment — no training run has been completed yet.

_variant_retrain_due._comment: Model trained, retrainBatchProgress has reached retrainBatchSize — a retrain will trigger on the next uncertain classification.
